result.title: Latent dynamics for reconstructing fine-scale PDE trajectories from coarse observations
result.summary: Coarse PDE observations omit spatial detail and intermediate states of evolving fields. We present Structured Latent Dynamics (SLD), a framework that reconstructs high-resolution trajectories from spatially and temporally downsampled simulations. SLD interpolates the input in time, adds a learned temporal correction and uses the resulting sequence to guide a hidden state on the coarse grid. Each update of the latent state combines a learned gated response with horizontal and vertical central differences and a five-point Laplacian of the state. The three spatial terms have learned channel-wise coefficients. Two Haar wavelet synthesis branches map the hidden state and refined coarse input to the high-resolution field. We evaluate SLD on two-dimensional Gray--Scott, complex Ginzburg--Landau and viscous Burgers systems, reconstructing 100 output frames from 25 input frames with eightfold refinement in each spatial direction. SLD achieves lower mean relative $L_2$ error and mean absolute error than unstructured latent dynamics and ConvLSTM baselines with comparable parameter counts, both on held-out trajectories and on later windows of trajectories used during training. SLD also reduces errors in regions with large reference gradients and across most or all of the evaluated later time intervals. A representative Gray--Scott comparison shows lower spectral error over most intermediate and high wavenumbers. Removing the fixed spatial response increased reconstruction error, supporting its contribution to the SLD architecture.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Structured Latent Dynamics（SLD），用时序插值与学习的时间修正引导粗网格隐藏状态，每步以门控响应叠加水平/垂直中心差分和五点 Laplacian 更新 latent，再用 Haar 小波合成分支重建高分辨率 PDE 轨迹；在 Gray–Scott、复 Ginzburg–Landau 和粘性 Burgers 上优于对照基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「带空间差分算子的门控 latent 状态递推 + 小波多尺度合成」结构，可能为 LVR 中如何在内部状态里保留细粒度视觉/空间细节、以及长程状态更新提供可供核查的建筑线索，但属纯科学计算场景，迁移性需自行判断。
